HowlOfTheFirstAge.title: Howl of the First Age
HowlOfTheFirstAge.description: A forgotten tribe has crawled out of the wilds, raiding caravans with stone and bone. If they aren’t driven back, their hunting grounds will soon include your clan.

TheSecondStoneAge.title: The Second Stone Age
TheSecondStoneAge.description: What was once a simple band has become something worse. If your clan does not act, they will soon rule these lands.

TheTwinSamurai.title: The Twin Samurai
TheTwinSamurai.description: Two master swordsmen walk your lands, cutting down any who challenge them. Defeat the twins before their legend drowns your clan in fear.

TheHelmLegion.title: The Helm Legion
TheHelmLegion.description: These fighters hide behind iron and heavy weapons, believing themselves untouchable. Show them that even steel bends before your clan.

TheBlackSails.title: The Black Sails
TheBlackSails.description: Ships without flags have anchored near your lands. The pirates plan to loot everything that isn’t nailed down.

TheThreeMusketeers.title: The Three Musketeers
TheThreeMusketeers.description: These masters seek to prove that only they deserve respect and rule. Show them your clan bows to no blade.

ThugAttack.title: Thug attack
ThugAttack.description: A gang of thugs has come to collect a “tax” on your clan’s hard-earned income. You’ve refused to pay, and now they’re at your gates. Stand your ground and show them your clan doesn't bow to threats.

TheLawComesKnocking.title: The Law comes knocking
TheLawComesKnocking.description: You turned down the dictator’s partnership, choosing freedom over chains. Now his armored units march in to make an example of your people.

ToxicVanguard.title: Toxic Vanguard
ToxicVanguard.description: A masked unit armed with forbidden tech has entered your territory, leaving scorched air behind them. Stop their advance before they cause more damage.

TheStarBlades.title: The Star Blades
TheStarBlades.description: A squad of glowing-sword warriors has landed, declaring your clan unfit to rule these lands. Drive them out before they decide your fate for good.

AlienInvasion.title: Alien Invasion
AlienInvasion.description: Beings from another star have begun to harvest your people like cattle. Fight back before your home becomes their colony.

TheColossalBlade.title: The Colossal Blade
TheColossalBlade.description: The warrior fights with a blade bigger than any house. If your clan cannot stop him, nothing else will.

DigitalBreach.title: Digital Breach
DigitalBreach.description: A tear in the data realm has unleashed strange warriors of light and numbers. Close the breach before they rewrite your lands.

TechIsNotEnough.title: Tech is not enough
TechIsNotEnough.description: Ordinary fighters have armed themselves with glowing tech blades, believing it makes them invincible. Prove that real strength still matters.

QuantumRebels.title: Quantum Rebels
QuantumRebels.description: A crew of flashy warriors has appeared, armed with unstable quantum weapons. Their power is wild and dangerous, and your clan must stop them before the damage spreads.

OrderOfTheThrone.title: Order of the Throne
OrderOfTheThrone.description: The ruler has sent his elite guards to bring your clan under the crown. Show that your clan answers to no throne.

TheTwoWizards.title: The Two Wizards
TheTwoWizards.description: The mages claim they come to “reshape” your territory to their liking. Your clan must answer steel with courage and break their enchantments.

DescendFromAbove.title: Descend from above
DescendFromAbove.description: A host of angels has descended, claiming your clan has grown too proud. Prove your worth, or be erased in the name of purity.

NightSorcerers.title: Night Sorcerers
NightSorcerers.description: Wherever these spellcasters walk, crops fail and people vanish. Drive them out before your home becomes another dead place.

FromTheUnderworld.title: From the Underworld
FromTheUnderworld.description: Warriors have risen from the depths where the living do not belong. If your clan fails to stop them, the surface will become their new kingdom.
